result.informal_name: Logarithm Tends to Infinity at Infinity
result.informal_description: The natural logarithm function tends to infinity as its argument approaches infinity, i.e., $\lim_{x \to \infty} \log x = \infty$.

name: ENNReal
log_eq_top_iff
result.informal_name: Logarithm Equals Infinity iff Argument is Infinity
result.informal_description: For any extended non-negative real number $ x $, the logarithm of $ x $ equals $ +\infty $ if and only if $ x $ itself is $ +\infty $. In symbols, $ \log(x) = +\infty \iff x = +\infty $.

name: Real
tendsto_abs_logb_atTop
result.signature: (hb : b ≠ -1 ∧ b ≠ 0 ∧ b ≠ 1) : Tendsto (|logb b ·|) atTop atTop
result.type: ∀ {b : ℝ}, b ≠ -1 ∧ b ≠ 0 ∧ b ≠ 1 → Filter.Tendsto (fun x => |Real.logb b x|) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop
result.value:
:= by
  wlog hb₀ : 0 < b generalizing b
  · exact (this (b := -b) (by simp [hb, neg_eq_iff_eq_neg]) (by linarith +splitNe)).congr (by simp)
  wlog hb₁ : 1 < b generalizing b
  ·
    exact
      (this (b := b⁻¹) (by simp [hb, inv_eq_iff_eq_inv, inv_neg]) (by simpa)
            ((one_lt_inv₀ hb₀).2 (by linarith +splitNe))).congr
        (by simp)
  refine (tendsto_logb_atTop hb₁).congr' ?_
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 1] with x hx₁
  rw [abs_of_nonneg]
  exact logb_nonneg hb₁ hx₁
result.informal_name: Absolute Value of $\log_b x$ Tends to Infinity as $x \to \infty$
result.informal_description: For any real number $b \neq -1, 0, 1$, the absolute value of the logarithm base $b$ of $x$ tends to infinity as $x$ approaches infinity. Formally, $\lim_{x \to \infty} |\log_b x| = \infty$.
